test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The volunteers of the organisation __refused point blank of do__ what was requested.

options.text: refused in point blank of doing

solution:
The correct answer is:** refused point blank to do**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The phrase **"refused point blank to do"** correctly follows the s
